page.layout: One page of text in a single column; faint show-through from the facing page at the right edge is ignored. Page number at top left, running head "C L." at top centre, catchword "Clien-" at bottom right.

main_text.p: stium. Objicere fores portæ, Ter. Obtrudere fores, Plaut. Operire oftium, Ter. Occludere, Oppilare, Cic.
Claudus utroque pede] Neutro pede utilis, Plin. Cleppus, Scal.
Clava] Sparus, Saluft. Virg. Sparum, Lucil. Mateola, Caton.
Clavis] Dens. Referare fores dente, Tibul.
Clavis falsa] Clavis adultera, Ovid. Adulterina, Taub. Clavis Laconica, Id. ex Plaut.
Claustrum (1) i.e. Sera] Claustrum Januæ, Catul. Clostrum, Cat. ant. Serraculum Palem. IC. Cloftellum, Petron.
Claustrum] (2) Cœnobium, Gell. Monasterium, Philon. Ascaeterium, in Cod.
Claustrum virginale] Parthenon. Gynæceum sacrum, Bud. Sacrarum virginum collegium. Cœnobium virginum, Isid.
Clausula] Exitus. Determinatio orationis Epilogus. Peroratio. Extrema oratio, Cic. Coronis, Mart. Colophon, Fest.
Clausus] Inclusus, Conclusus, Cic. Clausa domorum, Lucr. Intraclusus, Aggen.
Clemens] Æquum & bonum amans, sequens. Justus, Ter. Æqualem tenet juris rationem. Æquabilis in suos, Tacit. Æquabilem se præbet, Cic. Incruentus Princeps, Amm.
Clementer] Benevolè. Benignè. Benignissimè. Cum bonâ gratiâ. Amabiliter in aliquem cogitare, Cic. Indulgenter. Placidè, Liv. Indulgentissimè. Humanè, Sen. Dignanter, Vopisc. Placido vultu, Prop.
Clementia] Facilitas. Placabilitas. Indulgentia. Lenitas. Mansuetudo imperii, Æquitas, Cic. Benignitas, Plaut. Semper-lenitas, Terent.
Clericus] Initiatus sacris, Iun. Qui est in clero, Tertul.
Clerus, collegium Clericorum] Res Clerica & Ecclesiastica. Jus sacrosancti capitis, Bud.
Cliens alicujus] Clienta, Plaut. Qui in fide & clientelâ est. Cic. Sub umbrâ alicujus dilitescens. Commendatus in clientelam, Cic.
